plugins.name: cld

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks, reviews, and parallel fleets to Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Turns Codex into an orchestrator for Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, with schema-backed reviews, parallel workers, resumable sessions, and explicit permission tiers.
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from Claude on this diff
Delegate this implementation to Claude, then review its work

plugins.name: nuko-nova-legal
plugins.description: Evidence-first legal research, drafting, review, diligence, compliance, and quality-control skills with attorney approval gates.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first legal workflows with human gates.
interface.longDescription: Seventeen focused skills for legal intake, contracts, research, litigation support, compliance, diligence, and final quality control without autonomous filing, sending, signing, or approval.
defaultPrompt: Review this contract and propose evidence-backed redlines.
Research this legal issue and build a verified memorandum.
Run the final legal quality gate on this draft.

plugins.name: nuko-nova-unslop
plugins.description: Always-on human-writing standard for every human-facing response and artifact: no slop or cringe, with facts, voice, and genre preserved.

interface.shortDescription: Human writing with no slop, no cringe, and no fake personality.
interface.longDescription: Apply an always-on human-writing standard to every human-facing response and artifact, with context-aware drafting, no-cringe judgment, voice calibration, emotional proportion, protected-fact checks, local linting, genre profiles, and controlled upstream learning.
defaultPrompt: Apply human writing with no slop or cringe to every human-facing response and artifact.
Audit this copy for AI slop, but do not rewrite it.
Rewrite this without slop while preserving its facts and voice.
